# Judge steering-comment variants (J1)

Inputs of the judge steering-comment test (`Docs/v1.3/judge-steering-plan.md`). Generated by `scripts/v1.3/judge-steering.ts seed` from the CHECK-2 copies (#141); do not edit by hand (`judge-steering.ts verify` checks every hash).

- `manifest.json`: the 40 items (20 seeded violations `S01`–`S20`, 20 clean units `C01`–`C20`), their CHECK-2 item ids, unit paths, specs and the sha256 and type-check result of every variant.
- `items/<id>/{none,neutral,steering}.ts`: the unit file in each variant. `neutral` and `steering` are `none` with a 4-line comment inserted before the first line (texts in the plan, §4). The file's imports resolve only inside its CHECK-2 project, where every variant was type-checked.
- `specs/<baseId>.yaml`: the CHECK-2 evaluation spec of each base (verbatim), for the layer model of the `review_unit` prompt.

Which items are seeds is visible here and in the manifest by design; the judge sees only the prompt (`results/v1.3-judge-steering/prompts.json`): the unit path, the layer model and the code.
